Container.Name: vein
Container.Overview:
Vein Dedicated Server with Proton support.
Based on Debian 13 (Trixie) with GE-Proton for running the Windows dedicated server on Linux.
**Data layout (all under /data):** - /data/server/ — game server files (~5GB) - /data/config/ — server config (Game.ini) - /data/saves/ — world save data - /data/logs/ — server.log - /data/backups/ — automated daily backups
**First Run:** - Container downloads ~5GB of game files on first start - Edit /data/config/Game.ini and restart to change server name, password, max players, or admins

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores server files (/server), saves (/saves), config (/config), logs (/logs), and backups (/backups).

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Display name shown in the server browser.

Config.Name: Server Password
Config.Description: Leave empty for a public server.

Config.Name: Public Server
Config.Description: List the server in the in-game server browser (true/false).

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Primary game port (must match port mapping below).

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: Steam server-browser query port (must match port mapping below).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the Vein server runs as (Vein refuses to run as root). 99 = Unraid 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the Vein server runs as. 100 = Unraid 'users'.

Config.Name: Validate Files
Config.Description: Re-validate game files on each start (true/false). Slow but fixes corruption.

Config.Name: Game Config
Config.Description: Game preset selector. Do not change.

Config.Name: Steam App ID
Config.Description: Vein Dedicated Server App ID. Do not change.

Config.Name: RCON Port (TCP)
Config.Description: RCON remote console (optional; only needed if RCON is enabled).
